## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::SchemaVersionUnsupported` — the stored record carries a layout version this build does not understand.

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::an_unknown_record_version_fails_closed_on_every_path`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::an_unknown_record_version_fails_closed_on_every_path). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// SchemaVersionUnsupported — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
let stream = f.client.get_stream(&id);
// Forge a record tagged with a layout this build has never seen —
// exactly what a downgrade (or a corrupted write) would produce.
let future = crate::stream::VersionedStream {
    version: crate::stream::CURRENT_STREAM_RECORD_VERSION + 1,
    stream,
};
f.env.as_contract(&f.client.address, || {
    f.env
        .storage()
        .persistent()
        .set(&DataKey::Stream(id), &future);
});
Some(rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_get_stream(&id)))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked an_unknown_record_version_fails_closed_on_every_path
```

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Upgrade the client/indexer to a build that understands the stored record version, or migrate the record with `migrate_stream_version`; never decode an unknown layout.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/UPGRADES.md#phase-4b-per-record-layout-tags-and-migrate_stream_version`](../../docs/UPGRADES.md#phase-4b-per-record-layout-tags-and-migrate_stream_version)
